info.name: Cronitor Groups and Notifications Cronitor Telemetry API Search API

description.content:
The Groups API manages logical groupings of monitors for bulk operations and reporting. The Notifications API manages notification lists (alert routing) that specify where alerts are sent when monitors fire. Both APIs use HTTP Basic Auth with a Cronitor API key.
